{{Quote|The Balmorran Arms Factory is the Empire's biggest stronghold.|[[Warren Sedoru]]|<ref name="TOR:TA">{{TORcite|type=class|Jedi Knight|Tactical Advantages|Balmorra}}</ref>}}
The '''Balmorran Arms Factory''' was a weapons manufacturing plant owned by [[Balmorran Arms/Legends|Balmorran Arms]] until the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] [[Battle of Balmorra (Galactic Wars)|invaded]] the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Balmorra/Legends|Balmorra]] during the [[Great Galactic War]]. However, unlike the rest of the planet, the factory did not fall to the Empire and became a fortress for the [[Balmorran resistance]]. It also acted as a base for which republic troops could land in order to aid the resistance. In [[3643 BBY]] a new governor of [[Balmorra/Legends|Balmorra]], [[Darth Lachris]] hired an [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Imperial]] [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] to infiltrate the factory defeat [[Grand Marshal/Legends|Grand Marshal]] [[Cheketta]] and claim the factory for the empire.
